GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , crossed from Wide gate to lead rails 800m, rider went for home at 400m and he Set  up a big break and had them off the bit, started to feel the pinch last 100m and was claimed final 50m and had to settle for second spot # led/claimed late

Slow away. Pushed to recover & worked to led on rail by 1.5L @ 900m. Held 1/2L lead on insid midrace & pushed to quicken @ 450m. Pushed along Two Wide (1L clear) on home turn. Pressured on rail @ 250m & fought hard in last 150m to just hold on. # Led - held on.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. When questioned re leading rdr stated gelding is consistently ridden with vigour in early stages in an effort to hold a forward posn, however is typically is unable to do so. Rdr stated from a wider barrier today she rode her mount in a similar manner &, when it was not crossed by runners to its outside & with the addition of blinkers to its official race gear, it was able to gradually work forward & lead the event near the 1000m.
